booking_cta.summary: Every booking button in this build goes through WhatsApp, on desktop and on mobile. The Cal.com calendar option is in the code but switched off because calcom_link is empty in this build.
booking_cta.how_it_works_in_markup: Each 'Chat on WhatsApp' / 'Chat about cover' / 'Chat about a will' button is an <a class='btn-wa'> whose href is https://wa.me/27600156480?text=<prefilled message>. A click does not follow the link. It opens an in-page panel titled 'Continue on WhatsApp' with two checkboxes. The first is required: 'I agree that SortMyCover may message me on WhatsApp about my call and share my details with one authorised adviser. I am 18 or older.' The second is optional: 'Optional: let SortMyCover measure its Facebook and Instagram ads with my details in coded form.' The 'Open WhatsApp' button stays disabled until the first box is ticked, and 'Tick the first box to continue.' appears if someone tries before ticking. It then opens wa.me in a new tab. Under the button: 'Lindi, our AI assistant, replies. Ask for a person any time, or reply STOP to stop.'
booking_cta.prefilled_text_pattern: Hi Lindi, I'd like to chat about {topic}. I agree that SortMyCover may message me on WhatsApp about this and share my details with an authorised adviser. Ref {ref}[ via {source}]
booking_cta.prefilled_text_example_hero: Hi Lindi, I'd like to chat about cover for my family. I agree that SortMyCover may message me on WhatsApp about this and share my details with an authorised adviser. Ref w-home
booking_cta.source_tag: {source} comes from utm_source (instagram becomes ig, facebook becomes fb) or from an fbclid, so the WhatsApp opener carries the ad source.
booking_cta.desktop: The header has full navigation plus an amber 'Chat on WhatsApp' pill. A green floating 'Chat on WhatsApp' pill sits bottom right. The consent panel opens as a card above the floating pill. There is no Cal.com 'Pick a time' button: it is desk-only and turned off in this build.
booking_cta.mobile: The header shows the logo, an amber 'WhatsApp' pill and 'Menu'. The floating button is a round green icon with no label. The consent panel opens as a centred card over the page, with no dimmed backdrop. The flow is the same as on desktop.

files.key_copy: Short answer: A lender may require credit life insurance on a home loan, capped at what is still owed. The National Credit Act lets a borrower decline the lender's policy and use one of their own. A ceded policy pays the bank first. Life cover is a separate contract that pays the people named on it. This is information, not advice. / CTA: Book a 30-minute call with an authorised adviser

files.key_copy: SORTMYCOVER › LEARN › MYTHS AND DEFINITIONS / Income protection vs disability cover: what each one pays / By SortMyCover editorial team. Last reviewed 17 October 2026.

files.what_it_shows: The whole article, including the 'At a glance' comparison, sources and the booking CTA card.
files.key_copy: Short answer: Life cover pays when the insured person dies. Lump-sum disability cover pays once, usually only when a disability is permanent. Income protection pays a monthly amount based on earnings after a waiting period, and stops on recovery, death or the end of the benefit term. Each policy's definition of disability decides whether a claim pays. This is information, not advice.

files.key_copy: SORTMYCOVER › LEARN › LIFE EVENTS / Cover for business owners and directors: what changes without an employer / By SortMyCover editorial team. Last reviewed 17 October 2026.

files.what_it_shows: The whole article, including group scheme vs owner sections, UIF, sources and the booking CTA card.
files.key_copy: Short answer: Employees often have life and disability cover through an employer's group scheme. That cover belongs to the scheme and usually ends with the job, though some schemes offer a conversion option. An owner, director or self-employed person is in no scheme unless one is set up, so personal policies are usually the route. This is information, not advice.

files.key_copy: Short answer: Under the FAIS General Code of Conduct an authorised adviser must give a client the firm's details, its authorisation, how conflicts are handled and, where advice leads to a product, a written record of advice. Anyone can look an adviser up on the FSCA register, and can ask how the adviser is paid. This is information, not advice.

problems_seen: Home 'Two ways to start' cards: the .svc-who description ('With an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider…' and the Capital Legacy line) is styled color #D3D7DC on a white card, so it is almost invisible on desktop and mobile.

Mobile how-it-works: in the inline phone mock-ups, the chat header and Lindi's bubbles ('Lindi · SortMyCover', 'Hi, I'm Lindi…', 'Hi Lerato. Your adviser is…', 'Which time suits?') render light grey (#CFD4D9) on light bubbles and look washed out. The desktop sticky phone is fine.
Desktop header CTA renders as 'Chat on    WhatsApp' with a wide gap: the label breaks into two pieces. Other buttons are fine.
Desktop footer: '+27 10 976 5618 ·' leaves a dangling separator because the email wraps onto the next line.

The floating WhatsApp button covers some content: the 'Illustration. Names and times are examples.' caption on desktop, and on mobile the right edge of the 'Short answer' boxes and the last footer links.
The mobile consent panel has no dimmed backdrop, so hero text peeks out around it. The close button's ring sits tight on the panel edge.
Not a fault: the four life-moment photos (baby, income, business, will) only load when their tab is selected (lazy, hidden tabs). The files exist.
Not a fault: there is no Cal.com option anywhere because calcom_link is empty in this build.
Clean otherwise: no 404s, no console or page errors, and no horizontal overflow on any captured page at 1440 or 390.
